title: Aaine Mein Kiska Saaya Tha?
hooks: Mehul bathroom ke aaine ke saamne apne haathon ki laal siyahi dho raha tha.
Aaine ke andar ek aisa saaya dikha jo asal mein tha hi nahi.
Bijli gul hote hi aaine ke peeche ek khaufnaak sach samne aaya.
hook_why: Starts at frame 0 with immediate protagonist action and visual intrigue continuing from part 3.
metaphor: A haunting reflection revealing an entity lurking in the blind spot of reality.

cast.Mehul: 27 years old, tired brown eyes, messy black hair, wearing a faded blue cotton t-shirt, holding a cracked black smartphone.
cast.Vikrant: 27 years old, sharp features, neat black hair, wearing Mehul's faded blue cotton t-shirt, holding Mehul's cracked black smartphone.
cast.Raghav: 27 years old, Mehul's college friend and neighbour, cheerful round face, short curly hair, light stubble, mustard hoodie, always carries a steel water bottle
cast.Sharma ji: 58 years old, weathered face with deep laugh lines, thick graying mustache, receding salt-and-pepper hair tied in a small knot at the back, khaki watchman uniform with brass buttons and a faded society badge, always carries a wooden lathi with a red cloth wrapped around its handle

scenes.vo: Mehul bathroom ke aaine ke saamne apne haathon ki laal siyahi dho raha tha.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic night thriller still, rain outside, film grain, cold teal shadows, warm amber practical lights, Indian apartment bathroom. Mehul, 27, tired brown eyes, messy hair, faded blue t-shirt, scrubbing deep red ink off his wet hands under a running chrome faucet.

scenes.vo: Raghav darwaze par khada bola, bhai tu tension mat le, sab theek ho jayega.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic night thriller still, film grain, moody lighting. Raghav in a mustard hoodie standing by the wooden doorway of the bathroom, holding a stainless steel water bottle, speaking warmly with a supportive expression.

scenes.vo: Tabhi aaine ke reflection mein peeche ka peela bulb achanak jhilmilane laga.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic over-the-shoulder view into the bathroom mirror. In the glass reflection, the hallway behind shows a solitary vintage yellow filament bulb violently flickering and stuttering in the dark corridor.

scenes.vo: Aur agle hi pal poore ghar ki bijli ek jhatke mein gul ho gayi.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic darkness, deep shadows, moody teal moonlight cutting through bathroom window grilles. The bathroom and apartment corridor pitch into near-blackness, silhouettes barely visible in cold ambient light.

scenes.vo: Raghav bahar meter check karne dauda, aur Mehul bathroom mein akela reh gaya.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic thriller frame. Raghav hurrying out into the dark apartment hallway with a small phone flashlight, leaving Mehul alone inside the dim bathroom beside the damp sink.

scenes.vo: Mehul ne ghoom kar dekha, par corridor bilkul shaant aur khaali pada tha.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic wide shot from inside the bathroom looking out. Mehul turns his head back toward the open doorway, seeing only an empty, eerie, quiet corridor under dim blue shadows.

scenes.vo: Usne rahat ki saans li aur chehre par thande paani ke cheente maare.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic close-up. Mehul cupping cool tap water in his wet hands and splashing it across his tired face, drops running down his cheeks as he exhales in brief relief.

scenes.vo: Lekin jaise hi usne aaine mein dekha, uski saansein wahi tham gayin!
scenes.prompt: Cinematic thriller clip. Mehul lifts his wet face and looks directly into the mirror glass, his pupils dilating in sheer paralyzing shock as his breath catches.

scenes.vo: Haqeeqat mein Mehul akela tha, par aaine mein uske theek peeche koi khada tha!
scenes.prompt: Cinematic split perspective in mirror reflection. The physical bathroom behind Mehul is totally empty, yet inside the mirror glass a tall looming human figure stands directly behind his back.

scenes.vo: Ek lamba andhera saaya, jiska na koi chehra tha, na koi aawaz.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic spine-chilling close-up on the reflection. A tall, faceless dark silhouette cloaked in shadow standing motionless, blank void where facial features should be, eerie and menacing.

scenes.vo: Dheere se us saaye ne Mehul ke band bedroom ki taraf ungli utha di.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic mirror reflection view. The faceless dark silhouette raises a pale, slender arm and points an accusatory index finger toward Mehul's closed bedroom door visible in the reflection.

scenes.vo: Kya bedroom ke andar wahi kaatil chupa hai? Apni raye comments mein batao.
scenes.prompt: Cinematic vertical shot, dark hallway with a single wooden door slightly ajar, warm eerie light spilling through the crack onto the floor, centered composition, 9:16 aspect ratio, room above and below for text, no text, no logos.

caption:
Aaine mein dikha ek aisa saaya jo kamre mein tha hi nahi! 😱 Kya bedroom ke andar wahi chupa hai? Comments mein apna guess batao. Next part kal!
